answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by binding identities to deep hydrostatic telemetry. Nodes authenticate by sampling pressure fluctuations using piezoresistive sensors encased in polished onyx. Because local wave dynamics in the ocean cannot be simulated, an adversary cannot forge challenge responses without deploying discrete submerged hardware pods per identity. However, biofouling gradually dampens transducer sensitivity, causing occasional authentication dropouts.
